summary: HSBC Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing the fourth interim dividend for 2025 of US$0.45 per ordinary share, payable on 30 April 2026. The dividend is available in US dollars, sterling, or Hong Kong dollars; ADS holders receive US$2.25 per ADS. This routine dividend declaration does not constitute a special situation—it is an ordinary course distribution. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation for an extraordinary transaction, and no risk-arb event. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of a regular dividend payment.
